report: Lineup is set and there are no changes to make. The only alert is Rhamondre Stevenson (Questionable). He faces DET, which gives up the 2nd-most points to RBs here (rank 30), and he is averaging 16.43 over his last 3, so he starts unless he is ruled out. If he is out, Woody Marks steps in (17.3 carries a game, floor 8.28). At 2-7 the team is stuck with a thin bench and a QB with a low floor (Stafford 9.12). The best fixes are a QB upgrade from a team holding a spare, so send Zaneruth the Stroud offer first, then the Gavin and Cavery offers.

team_breakdown.note: Stafford averages 15.87 but is down to 12.33 over the last 3, with a 9.12 floor. That is risky each week.
Javonte Williams is excellent (17.73, 23 carries a game). Rachaad White (9.74) and the questionable Stevenson (12.63) are weak RB2 and flex options.
Higgins is 19.98, with 28.17 over his last 3. McMillan (15.56) is solid and Jameson Williams (13.21) is fine at flex.
LaPorta averages 11.64 but is down to 5.5 over his last 3. He has a good matchup against NE (rank 26 vs TE).
Flournoy (9.31) and Marks (8.86) are playable but are not scoring-threat options.
Nobody on the bench is above 9.3 apart from Dell (13.0 in only 2 games). McGowan (3.63) and Black (4.71) are dead weight.

plan: Land a bench-QB upgrade (Stroud or Shough) to lift the QB floor from 9.12 to 14-16
Swap a weak RB2 for Swift or Tuten, who get 13-20 touches
Cut McGowan and Knight and use the roster spots on the trades above

replacements.why: Likely a one-game issue; Marks has 17 carries a game and an 8.28 floor.

trades.why: C.J. Stroud averages 20.51 (24.95 over his last 3) with a 16.48 floor, against Stafford's 15.87 and 9.12 floor, so this is MORE RELIABLE and also MORE POINTS. Zane sits Stroud behind Jayden Daniels (19.42). His WR bench is thin (Ayomanor 5.0, Tate out) and he receives Dell's 13.0 and a usable flex.
